plain.li: I've been leaning on the same three workings for a year. Time to learn new ones, and do the old ones properly.
[spark:Council_Moment_ComparedWorkings] Another mage showed me what their school can do, and I knew half of it was within my reach. I'll reach for it.
[spark:battle] In the fight I wanted a working I didn't have. I won't be caught short like that again.
[trait:Necromancer|trait:Lich] There are deeper workings than the ones I use. I'll go down to them, carefully.

cold.li: Every working I add is another option in a fight. I'll add {COUNT}.

cheerful.li: New spells! I've a list, and I'm going to work through every one of them.

gloomy.li: The gift doesn't stand still. If I don't grow, it'll grow wild.

plain.li: I counted my workings tonight and there are more than there were. The new ones are starting to feel like mine.
What used to take a long breath now takes a short one.

warm.li: Everything I've learned is for the people here. I hope I never need half of it.

cheerful.li: I did it! Every working on the list, and two that weren't.

plain.li: I know my forms. I don't know enough of them, and the ones I know have gone dull.
[spark:downed] I went down because I had one answer and the enemy had two. I need more answers.
[spark:Council_Moment_ComparedForms] Watching another fighter's forms showed me how much I've let slide.

blunt.li: More techniques. Better ones. Every morning until I have them.

cold.li: A fighter with one trick dies to the second enemy. I'll learn {COUNT} more.

plain.li: I have answers now I didn't have before. My body knows them before I think of them.
Trained every morning this season, and it shows. I'm a different fighter.

warm.li: Whatever comes over the wall now, I can stand in front of the others.

ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.label: a scholar of the art
ColonyCouncil.AspirationDef.goal: understand the theory as well as the practice

plain.li: I can do things I can't explain. That isn't good enough. I want to understand why the workings work.
[spark:Council_Moment_TalkedMagic] Someone asked me what magic is and I had no answer. I'm going to find one.
[skill:Intellectual] The old texts say more than I've let them. I'll read them properly this time.

cold.li: Power without understanding is a gamble. I'll stop gambling.

gloomy.li: Every mage who died young thought they understood enough.

plain.li: I can explain my workings now, start to finish, and the explanation holds.
Wrote out the theory behind my strongest working tonight. Three pages. It's right.

warm.li: I understand it well enough now to teach it. Anyone with the gift only has to ask.

plain.li: The gift I have is for mending. I'll use it on everyone who needs it, not only when it's easy.
[spark:loss] I couldn't save them. Next time I'll be better than I was.
[spark:battle] Too many came back from that fight bleeding. I'll be ready for the next one.

warm.li: Every hurt I can mend is one less someone has to carry. That's enough of a reason.

cold.li: A healer is measured in patients. I'll count mine.

plain.li: Sixty tended since I set my mind to it. I remember most of their faces.
My hands are steadier than they were a year ago, and the gift answers faster.

warm.li: Everyone I tended is still here to complain about my bedside manner. Good.

gloomy.li: Sixty tended. There will be sixty more.
